name: location-scout
description: Self-hosted map of favourite photography spots and when the light works

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.test.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p web
